title: 360 Launches Enterprise Intelligent Agent Platform NanoWork, First Users Receive 100 Million Token Trial Allocation
excerpt: Founder of 360 Group, Zhou Hongyi, officially launched the new enterprise intelligent agent work platform "NanoWork", designed for enterprise owners, entreprene
content_html:
Founder of 360 Group, Zhou Hongyi, officially launched the new enterprise intelligent agent work platform "NanoWork", designed for enterprise owners, entrepreneurs, sole proprietorships (OPC), and enterprise employees to create AI-driven "super organizations", promoting the transition of enterprises from using AI tools to intelligent agent collaborative work.

At the launch event, Zhou Hongyi stated that enterprise leaders need to lead by example when implementing AI applications. He announced that the first users of NanoWork would receive a trial quota of 100 million Tokens each, and through professional training and support services, he plans to prioritize helping 1,000 small businesses implement AI and improve operational efficiency.

According to the introduction, before the product launch, 360 used itself as a test scenario, applying intelligent agents such as OpenClaw to over 1,000 real business scenarios within the company, collecting more than 56,000 user feedbacks, and completing 166 version iterations in 5 months, finally launching NanoWork. Zhou Hongyi emphasized that this platform is not simply packaging a single intelligent agent, but rather hiding complex technical details and transforming advanced capabilities like large models and intelligent agents into directly usable productivity for enterprises, while integrating security features.

NanoWork is built around five core systems: multi-intelligent agent engine, multi-model foundation, cloud office, multi-work mode, and multi-expert system. Users do not need to master models, frameworks, or tools; they just need to set a goal, and the platform can coordinate different AI experts to complete tasks based on the requirements, automatically matching suitable models and execution methods.

In terms of application scenarios, enterprise managers can use NanoWork for business analysis, growth, and progress management; entrepreneurs and sole proprietorships can complete opportunity exploration, product validation, content creation, and marketing acquisition; enterprise employees can leverage AI to improve research analysis, solution planning, content creation, and project delivery efficiency.

Regarding the security challenges brought by intelligent agents performing tasks, Zhou Hongyi pointed out that "a large model making a mistake is saying the wrong thing, while an intelligent agent making a mistake is doing the wrong thing." 360 has made "native security, built-in from the factory" the core design principle of NanoWork, reducing enterprise AI application risks through mechanisms such as cloud isolation, permission control, and data protection.

content_html_zh:
360集团创始人周鸿祎正式推出全新企业智能座席工作平台“NanoWork”，专为企业主、企业家、独资企业（OPC）、企业员工打造AI驱动的“超级组织”，推动企业从使用AI工具向智能座席协同工作转变。

发布会上，周鸿祎表示，企业领导者在实施人工智能应用时需要以身作则。 他宣布，NanoWork的首批用户将获得每人1亿个Token的试用额度，并计划通过专业培训和支持服务，优先帮助1000家小企业实施人工智能并提高运营效率。

据介绍，在产品发布前，360以自身为测试场景，将OpenClaw等智能代理应用于公司内部1000多个真实业务场景，收集超过56000条用户反馈，5个月内完成166个版本迭代，最终推出NanoWork。 周鸿祎强调，这个平台不是简单地封装单个智能体，而是隐藏复杂的技术细节，将大模型、智能体等先进能力转化为企业直接可用的生产力，同时集成安全特性。

NanoWork围绕五个核心系统构建：多智能代理引擎、多模型基础、云办公、多工作模式、多专家系统。 用户不需要掌握模型、框架或工具；他们只需要设定一个目标，平台就可以根据需求协调不同的人工智能专家完成任务，自动匹配合适的模型和执行方法。

在应用场景上，企业管理者可以使用NanoWork进行业务分析、增长、进度管理；企业家和独资企业可以完成机会探索、产品验证、内容创建和营销获取；企业员工可以利用人工智能来提高研究分析、解决方案规划、内容创建和项目交付效率。

对于智能体执行任务带来的安全挑战，周鸿祎指出，“大模型犯错就是说错了事，智能体犯错就是做错了事”。 360将“原生安全、出厂内置”作为NanoWork的核心设计原则，通过云隔离、权限控制、数据保护等机制降低企业AI应用风险。
